affected_system: municipal buildings, distributed energy, electrification, and emissions management
alternatives: advance high-risk work within verified feasible windows for municipal building decarbonization project schedule

assumptions: Meters, fuels, tariffs, weather, occupancy, equipment, projects, and emissions factors are versioned.
Modeled energy and carbon savings remain distinct from measured post-project performance.
All alternatives, capacities, costs, effects, thresholds, and failure scenarios are proposed until bound to evidence.

constraints.description: The municipal energy and building decarbonization schedule must respect declared labor, access, sequencing, notice, and completion windows.
Every released metric must retain evidence type, source lineage, geography, time, assumptions, and uncertainty.
No analytical output may bypass lawful authority, accountable human review, or an applicable appeal process.

decision_cadence: recompiled at each planning cycle and after material evidence change
decision_owner: municipal energy director and public-building portfolio manager
decision_question: When should audits, design, procurement, shutdowns, installation, commissioning, and measurement occur?

independence_key.binding_constraint: The municipal energy and building decarbonization schedule must respect declared labor, access, sequencing, notice, and completion windows.
independence_key.evidence_gate: Evidence for municipal building decarbonization project schedule passes documented checks for effective dates, time zones, calendars, lead times, completion semantics, and update cadence.
independence_key.intervention_mechanism: dependency, occupancy, procurement, season, and workforce scheduling

intended_claim: A versioned schedule design for comparing declared alternatives affecting municipal building decarbonization project schedule, conditional on its evidence gate.
limitations: This library record has no city binding and therefore reports no local input, output, or recommendation.
Readiness describes explicit source and method gates; it does not certify implementation feasibility.
External domain, legal, community, security, and operational review remains outside this design artifact.

objectives.metric: distributional gap in project-days beyond feasible emissions-reduction milestones
decision claims with complete evidence lineage

prohibited_claims: Do not call a scheduled project procured, installed, commissioned, or operational.
Do not describe a design-only record as a city execution, deployment, adopted policy, or impact result.
Do not relabel proposed, estimated, simulated, optimized, or causal evidence as observed evidence.
Do not infer individual behavior, protected status, harm, or entitlement from aggregate records.

release_gate.failure_release: Release an explicit insufficient-evidence record naming missing sources, failed diagnostics, prohibited claims, and the next validation action.
release_gate.pass_condition: Evidence for municipal building decarbonization project schedule passes documented checks for effective dates, time zones, calendars, lead times, completion semantics, and update cadence.

title: Schedule building decarbonization and commissioning
